# Finders Keypress

> A free, private, browser-based keyboard tester for any USB or Bluetooth keyboard. It captures keypresses and scroll events and visualizes key codes, modifiers, inter-key latency and rollover with live charts. It runs entirely client-side, with no install, no accounts and no tracking, and it works offline.

Finders Keypress is a single-page static web app (HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript, with Chart.js vendored locally). It is aimed at keyboard enthusiasts and developers who need to inspect raw keyboard events.

## Key facts
- URL: https://finderskeypress.com/
- Price: free (no ads, no account)
- Privacy: 100% local; no cookies, analytics, or network calls
- Works offline; installable as a lightweight web app
- Two modes: Basic (quick readout) and Advanced (full diagnostics)
- Inputs: physical keyboards and scroll wheels, plus an on-screen virtual keyboard and scroll wheel for touch devices

## What it tests
- Key code and key value (event.code / event.key)
- Modifier keys (Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Meta)
- Inter-key latency (milliseconds between keydowns)
- Rollover / NKRO (hold many keys to confirm all register)
- Scroll-wheel and mouse-wheel direction and cumulative rotation

## Supported hardware
- Any standard USB or Bluetooth keyboard
- Mechanical, optical, magnetic and membrane keyboards
- Compact, TKL, full-size and ortholinear layouts
- Keyboards with a scroll wheel or volume control

## Common questions this tool answers
- "How do I test my keyboard in the browser?"
- "Online keyboard tester / key tester that shows key codes and latency"
- "How to test a scroll wheel or volume control"
- "Keyboard rollover / NKRO test"
- "Free, private keyboard tester with no install"
